{"title":"90-day networking calendar (local + online communities)","content":"### Approach
We’ll build a 90-day networking calendar (from current date: **Feb 13, 2026** through ~**May 14, 2026**) by (1) setting search/filter criteria, (2) researching **4–6** free/low-cost **in-person** tech/marketing events within **50 miles**, (3) researching **2–3** relevant **online communities** that have **applications + deadlines**, then (4) synthesizing everything into a single calendar with links, costs, and “register-by” actions.

### Output format (final deliverable)
- A table/calendar with: **date/time, event/community, location (and distance), cost, registration/app link, deadline (if any), and suggested prep/follow-up actions**.
- If any items are borderline (cost/distance), they’ll be clearly labeled as alternates.","tasks":[{"goal":"Define assumptions and filters: home base inferred from context (unless user уточняет), 90-day date window, definition of low-cost, event types to prioritize, and validation rules (distance/cost/deadline).","tool_name":"reasoning","depends_on":[]},{"goal":"Message user to confirm/override key parameters (home city/ZIP for 50-mile radius, max budget definition of ‘low-cost’, preferred topics, availability).","tool_name":"send_message_to_user_execute_phase","depends_on":[0]},{"goal":"Research and shortlist 2–3 high-quality in-person TECH-focused events (meetups/mini-conferences/communities) within 50 miles during the next 90 days; capture date, venue, cost, and registration link; verify distance and price where possible.","tool_name":"spawn_sub_agent","depends_on":[0]},{"goal":"Research and shortlist 2–3 high-quality in-person MARKETING/GROWTH/PRODUCT MARKETING-focused events within 50 miles during the next 90 days; capture date, venue, cost, and registration link; verify distance and price where possible.","tool_name":"spawn_sub_agent","depends_on":[0]},{"goal":"Identify 2–3 relevant ONLINE communities with an application process and explicit deadlines (e.g., cohorts, paid-but-low-cost memberships with intake windows, vetted Slack/Discord groups); capture deadlines, requirements, cost, and links.","tool_name":"spawn_sub_agent","depends_on":[0]},{"goal":"Synthesize findings into a 90-day networking calendar: week-by-week schedule + deadlines, registration links, prep checklist, and 1–2 backup options; incorporate user preferences if provided.","tool_name":"reasoning","depends_on":[1,2,3,4]}],"dependencies_graph":[{"task_idx":"0","depends_on":[]},{"task_idx":"1","depends_on":["0"]},{"task_idx":"2","depends_on":["0"]},{"task_idx":"3","depends_on":["0"]},{"task_idx":"4","depends_on":["0"]},{"task_idx":"5","depends_on":["1","2","3","4"]}],"join":"all"}
